name: warapp-mcp
description: Read-only war.app (Warzone) game advisor for Claude — your games, maps, bonuses, board analysis and route planning via the GameFeed API

email.title: war.app email
email.description: The email address you sign in to war.app with.

api_token.title: war.app API token
api_token.description: Your API token, shown at https://war.app/API/GetAPIToken while signed in. Changing your password rotates it.

env_file.title: Credentials file (optional)
env_file.description: Optional dotenv file holding WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN. Defaults to ~/.config/warapp-mcp/.env.

tools.name: warapp_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that war.app accepts your email and API token

tools.name: warapp_get_game
tools.description: Look up a war.app game: state, turn, players and who has committed, settings digest

tools.name: warapp_get_map
tools.description: Rank a game map's bonuses (easiest first) and find its chokepoints

tools.name: warapp_analyze_board
tools.description: Advise a player from the board: income, closest bonuses, armies needed, threats

tools.name: warapp_plan_route
tools.description: Shortest path between two territories on a game's map
